title: Error Codes Schema
description: 全局错误码契约。统一定义所有模块对外错误码、消息模板、HTTP 状态码映射，避免模块间异常拦截歧义。来源：scheme-final-merged.md 任务清单 §28 + rules-3 §1.2 错误码契约强制要求。所有模块抛出异常必须使用此处定义的错误码。v4.28.0 扩展：新增 14 个腐竹经济域错误码（admin_wallet/withdrawal/settlement/admin_tier/self_hosted_node，见 predefined_codes 尾部），category 枚举新增 node/demo 两类。v3-billing 扩展：新增 6 个 VPS 计费域错误码（instance_type_pricing/instance_billing_settings/instance_expired/billing_exempt/invalid_billing_cycle/global_balance_insufficient，见 predefined_codes 尾部），category 枚举新增 billing 一类。

code.description: 错误码标识（大写字母数字下划线）。如 'USER_NOT_FOUND'

message_template.description: 消息模板，使用 {placeholder} 占位。如 'User not found: {user_id}'

http_status.description: HTTP 状态码映射。400=客户端参数错误；401=未认证；403=无权限；404=资源不存在；409=冲突（如乐观锁抢占失败）；429=限流；500=服务端错误；502=上游不可达（如 Daemon 不可达）；503=服务不可用

category.description: 错误分类，便于模块归属与日志聚合。v1 扩展：新增 wallet / recharge / refund / coupon / expiry / quota / points 七类（保留既有 12 类）。v4.28.0 扩展：新增 node / demo 两类（demo 修复 DEMO_MODE_DISABLED 既有类目越界不一致）

retryable.description: 是否可重试。true=调用方可重试（如 Daemon 临时不可达、乐观锁超时）；false=不可重试（如用户不存在）

description.description: 错误码详细描述，说明触发场景与处理建议

predefined_codes.description: 预定义错误码清单（文档参考用，实际约束由 error_codes 数组提供）

USER_NOT_FOUND.description: 用户不存在。触发场景：根据 user_id 查询用户记录未命中

INVALID_CREDENTIAL.description: 登录凭证错误。触发场景：邮箱或密码不匹配。不区分邮箱不存在与密码错误以防枚举攻击

VIP_LEVEL_INSUFFICIENT.message_template: VIP level {actual} insufficient, required {required} for quality {quality}
VIP_LEVEL_INSUFFICIENT.description: VIP 等级不足。触发场景：用户 VIP 等级不满足物品品质要求（VIP N 可购 tier ≤ N-1）

SHOP_ITEM_NOT_FOUND.message_template: Shop item not found or disabled: {item_name} on server {server_id}
SHOP_ITEM_NOT_FOUND.description: 商品不存在或已下架。触发场景：shop_items 查询未命中或 enabled=false

SHOP_ORDER_ALREADY_CLAIMED.message_template: Shop order already claimed or in progress: {claim_code}
SHOP_ORDER_ALREADY_CLAIMED.description: 订单已被领取或正在领取中。触发场景：乐观锁 UPDATE 影响行数=0（status 非 pending）

CDK_CODE_INVALID.description: CDK 兑换码无效或已过期。触发场景：cdk_codes 查询未命中或 status=expired

CDK_ALREADY_REDEEMED.message_template: CDK code already redeemed or in progress: {code}
CDK_ALREADY_REDEEMED.description: CDK 已兑换或正在兑换中。触发场景：乐观锁 UPDATE 影响行数=0（status 非 unused）

COMMAND_RENDER_FAILED.message_template: Command render failed: template={template}, variable {var}={value} failed pattern {pattern}
COMMAND_RENDER_FAILED.description: 命令模板渲染失败（含注入校验失败）。触发场景：变量值不匹配 VARIABLE_PATTERNS 正则。命令不下发，直接抛错

PACK_LOAD_FAILED.description: Pack 加载失败。触发场景：Pack YAML 解析失败、schema 校验失败、文件不存在

DAEMON_UNREACHABLE.description: Daemon 不可达。触发场景：HTTP/WS 连接失败、超时。可重试，commandDispatcher 进入重试队列

INSTANCE_NOT_RUNNING.description: 服务器实例未运行。触发场景：下发命令时 status 非 running

OPTIMISTIC_LOCK_TIMEOUT.message_template: Optimistic lock timeout: resource={resource_type}:{resource_id}, stuck in {stuck_status} for {seconds}s
OPTIMISTIC_LOCK_TIMEOUT.description: 乐观锁超时。触发场景：shop_orders/cdk_codes 停在 claiming 状态 >5 分钟，定时任务回滚前其他请求等待超时。可重试

USER_ALREADY_EXISTS.description: 用户已存在。触发场景：注册时邮箱已被占用

VERIFY_CODE_INVALID.message_template: Verify code invalid or expired: code={code}
VERIFY_CODE_INVALID.description: 验证码无效或已过期。触发场景：玩家绑定验证码不匹配或超过 TTL

VIP_PERMISSION_NOT_FOUND.message_template: VIP permission config not found: level={vip_level}
VIP_PERMISSION_NOT_FOUND.description: VIP 权限配置不存在。触发场景：vip_permissions 表查询未命中对应等级

DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message_template: Daily purchase limit exceeded: user={user_id}, server={server_id}, current={current}, limit={limit}
DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: 超出每日购买限额。触发场景：用户当日购买数已达 vip_permissions.daily_limit 上限

COMMAND_QUEUE_FULL.message_template: Command queue full: server_id={server_id}, queue_size={size}, max={max}
COMMAND_QUEUE_FULL.description: 命令队列已满。触发场景：command_queue 表条数达 queue_max_size 上限，丢弃低优先级命令

PACK_VALIDATION_FAILED.description: Pack schema 校验失败。触发场景：pack.yaml 不通过 zod schema 校验

PACK_NOT_FOUND.description: Pack 不存在。触发场景：packs 表查询未命中

ITEM_SYNC_FAILED.description: 物品同步失败。触发场景：GitHub raw 拉取失败、解析失败。可重试

VOTE_NOT_FOUND.description: 投票不存在。触发场景：votes 表查询未命中

VOTE_ALREADY_CLOSED.description: 投票已关闭。触发场景：对非 active 状态投票执行操作

VOTE_THRESHOLD_NOT_MET.message_template: Vote threshold not met: vote_id={vote_id}, current={current}, required={required}
VOTE_THRESHOLD_NOT_MET.description: 投票阈值未达。触发场景：投票结束但赞成票数不足

GIFT_ALREADY_CLAIMED.message_template: Welcome gift already claimed: user={user_id}, server={server_id}
GIFT_ALREADY_CLAIMED.description: 欢迎礼包已领取。触发场景：gift_claims 表已有该用户记录

MOD_NOT_FOUND.message_template: Mod not found: mod_name={mod_name} on server {server_id}
MOD_NOT_FOUND.description: Mod 不存在。触发场景：mod_records 表查询未命中

MOD_INSTALL_FAILED.description: Mod 安装失败。触发场景：下载失败、解压失败、依赖冲突。可重试

SAVE_NOT_FOUND.message_template: Save not found: save_name={save_name} on server {server_id}
SAVE_NOT_FOUND.description: 存档不存在。触发场景：save_records 表查询未命中

BACKUP_NOT_FOUND.description: 备份不存在。触发场景：backup_records 表查询未命中

BACKUP_FAILED.description: 备份失败。触发场景：磁盘满、压缩失败、pre_backup_commands 失败。可重试

MONITOR_DATA_NOT_FOUND.message_template: Monitor data not found: server_id={server_id}, range={start}~{end}
MONITOR_DATA_NOT_FOUND.description: 监控数据不存在。触发场景：monitor_snapshots 表在指定时间范围内无数据

ENTRY_NOT_FOUND.message_template: List entry not found: list_type={list_type}, player={player_name}
ENTRY_NOT_FOUND.description: 名单条目不存在。触发场景：list_entries 表查询未命中

ENTRY_ALREADY_EXISTS.message_template: List entry already exists: list_type={list_type}, player={player_name}
ENTRY_ALREADY_EXISTS.description: 名单条目已存在。触发场景：插入重复 (server_id, list_type, player_name)

WEBHOOK_NOT_FOUND.description: Webhook 不存在。触发场景：webhooks 表查询未命中

WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_FAILED.description: Webhook 投递失败。触发场景：目标 URL 返回非 2xx 或连接失败。可重试

MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND.description: 定时消息不存在。触发场景：periodic_messages 表查询未命中

INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND.description: 实例不存在。触发场景：servers 表查询未命中或 Daemon 无对应实例目录

SYSTEM_UPDATE_001.message_template: System update download failed: url={url}, reason={reason}
SYSTEM_UPDATE_001.description: 系统更新下载失败。触发场景：manifest 拉取失败、tar 下载失败、网络不可达。可重试

SYSTEM_UPDATE_002.message_template: System update sha256 verification failed: expected={expected}, actual={actual}
SYSTEM_UPDATE_002.description: 系统更新 sha256 校验失败。触发场景：下载包损坏或被篡改。不重试，需检查 manifest

SYSTEM_UPDATE_003.description: 系统更新 knex 迁移失败。触发场景：migrate.latest 抛错。回滚 symlink，保留 previous

SYSTEM_METRICS_001.description: 系统指标采集失败。触发场景：/proc/stat 等系统文件不可读。可重试

SYSTEM_FIX_001.message_template: Invalid fixId or fix not whitelisted: {fixId}
SYSTEM_FIX_001.description: 修复 ID 无效或不在白名单。触发场景：fixId 不在 diagnostic-fixes.json 白名单中，或脚本路径越界 ./scripts/

SYSTEM_JOB_NOT_FOUND.description: 更新任务不存在。触发场景：getUpdateStatus(jobId) 查询未命中 system_update_jobs 表

AUTH_PWD_001.description: 改密时旧密码不匹配。触发场景：updatePassword 的 oldPassword 参数与当前密码 hash 不匹配。不区分用户不存在以防枚举

AUTH_PWD_002.message_template: Password strength insufficient: zxcvbn score {actual} < required {required}
AUTH_PWD_002.description: 密码强度未达 min_zxcvbn_score。触发场景：zxcvbn(newPassword).score < auth.password_policy.min_zxcvbn_score（默认 3）

AUTH_PWD_003.description: 新密码命中最近 max_history 条历史密码。触发场景：bcrypt.compare(newPassword, history.hash) 命中

BUILT_IN_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_READONLY.description: 系统内置账号密码不可修改。触发场景：尝试修改 users.is_built_in=1 的账号密码（演示场景下 admin/manager/user 三个 *@local.dev 账号）。前端应在改密按钮处显示系统内置标识并禁用按钮

DEMO_MODE_DISABLED.message_template: Demo mode is not enabled (VITE_ENABLE_DEMO must be true)
DEMO_MODE_DISABLED.description: 演示模式未启用。触发场景：VITE_ENABLE_DEMO=false 时调用 /api/demo/reset。前端应隐藏「重置演示」按钮

INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.message_template: Insufficient wallet balance: required={required}, actual={actual}, user={user_id}, server={server_id}
INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.description: 钱包余额不足。触发场景：下单/续费/付费 CDK 兑换时 balance < amount。注：既有 impl errors.ts:498 已用此 code，本次首次纳入 public 契约（B-NEW-2 修复：保留既有命名，http_status 对齐既有 shop.ts:409 的 400）

DAILY_REWARD_ALREADY_CLAIMED.message_template: Daily reward already claimed today: user={user_id}, server={server_id}, date={date}
DAILY_REWARD_ALREADY_CLAIMED.description: 今日已领取每日点券奖励。触发场景：walletService.claimDailyReward 按 last_daily_claim_date 判断今日已领。注：既有 impl errors.ts:507 已用此 code，本次首次纳入 public 契约（S-NEW-2 修复）

WALLET_NOT_FOUND.description: 钱包不存在。触发场景：用户在某实例未创建钱包（未绑定）

RECHARGE_CDK_INVALID.description: 充值 CDK 不存在。触发场景：recharge_cdks 查询未命中

RECHARGE_CDK_ALREADY_REDEEMED.message_template: Recharge CDK already redeemed or in progress: code={code}
RECHARGE_CDK_ALREADY_REDEEMED.description: 充值 CDK 已兑换或正在兑换中。触发场景：乐观锁 UPDATE 影响行数=0（status 非 unused）

RECHARGE_CDK_EXPIRED.description: 充值 CDK 已过期。触发场景：expires_at < now

RECHARGE_CDK_BATCH_NOT_FOUND.message_template: Recharge CDK batch not found: batch_id={batch_id}
RECHARGE_CDK_BATCH_NOT_FOUND.description: 充值 CDK 批次不存在。触发场景：recharge_cdk_batches 查询未命中

RECHARGE_CDK_BATCH_CREATE_FAILED.message_template: Recharge CDK batch create failed: reason={reason}
RECHARGE_CDK_BATCH_CREATE_FAILED.description: 充值 CDK 批次创建失败。触发场景：total_count 超限 / face_value 非法 / 批量插入失败

REFUND_ORDER_NOT_FOUND.description: 退款申请不存在。触发场景：wallet_refund_orders 查询未命中

REFUND_ORDER_NOT_PENDING.message_template: Refund order not pending: refund_id={refund_id}, current_status={status}
REFUND_ORDER_NOT_PENDING.description: 退款申请非 pending 状态。触发场景：approve/reject 时 status 非 pending

REFUND_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_LIMIT.message_template: Refund amount exceeds limit: requested={requested}, max={max}
REFUND_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_LIMIT.description: 退款金额超限。触发场景：amount > system_config.wallet.refund_max_amount

ORDER_NOT_REFUNDABLE.description: 订单不可退款。触发场景：shop_orders.status != 'pending'（已领取订单需走补偿发放）

COUPON_INVALID.description: 优惠券无效或已过期。触发场景：coupons 查询未命中或 valid_until < now

COUPON_ALREADY_CLAIMED.message_template: Coupon already claimed by user: code={code}, user={user_id}
COUPON_ALREADY_CLAIMED.description: 用户已领取过该优惠券。触发场景：user_coupons 已有 active 记录

COUPON_USAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message_template: Coupon usage limit exceeded: code={code}, used={used}, limit={limit}
COUPON_USAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: 优惠券已达使用上限。触发场景：coupons.used_count >= coupons.usage_limit

COUPON_NOT_APPLICABLE.description: 优惠券不适用于当前订单。触发场景：min_order_amount 不满足 / scope 不匹配 / 已过期

INSTANCE_NOT_RENEWABLE.description: 实例不可续费。触发场景：expiry_status='cleaned'（已清理磁盘的实例不可恢复）

INSTANCE_EXPIRY_CONFIG_ERROR.message_template: Instance expiry config error: key={key}, value={value}, reason={reason}
INSTANCE_EXPIRY_CONFIG_ERROR.description: 实例到期配置错误。触发场景：system_config.instance.expiry.* 配置项缺失或非法

QUOTA_LIMIT_REACHED.message_template: Quota limit reached: user={user_id}, resource={resource_type}, used={used}, limit={limit}
QUOTA_LIMIT_REACHED.description: 配额已达上限。触发场景：创建实例/上传文件时超 max_instances / max_disk_mb / max_players_total

QUOTA_CONFIG_ERROR.description: 配额配置错误。触发场景：vip.quota_overrides JSON 解析失败

VIP_POINTS_CONFIG_ERROR.message_template: VIP points config error: key={key}, reason={reason}
VIP_POINTS_CONFIG_ERROR.description: VIP 积分配置错误。触发场景：vip.points_thresholds JSON 解析失败或等级缺失

VIP_LEVEL_UPGRADE_FAILED.message_template: VIP level upgrade failed: user={user_id}, server={server_id}, target_level={target_level}, reason={reason}
VIP_LEVEL_UPGRADE_FAILED.description: VIP 等级升级失败。触发场景：vipService.setVipLevel 抛错（无 active 绑定记录等）

VIP_CHECKIN_ALREADY_TODAY.message_template: VIP checkin already done today: user={user_id}, server={server_id}, date={date}
VIP_CHECKIN_ALREADY_TODAY.description: 今日已签到。触发场景：last_checkin_date == today

BINDING_NOT_FOUND.message_template: Active binding not found: user={user_id}, server={server_id}
BINDING_NOT_FOUND.description: 无 active 绑定记录。触发场景：vipPointService.addPoints / checkin 时用户未绑定实例（需先 bindInstance）。注：既有 vipService.updateBindingVip 也抛此错误，本错误码统一覆盖

ADMIN_WALLET_NOT_FOUND.description: 腐竹账户不存在。触发场景：admin_wallets 查询未命中（正常路径应先 getOrCreateAdminWallet 自动创建，仅极端情况抛出）

ADMIN_WALLET_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.message_template: Admin wallet insufficient balance: required={required}, actual={actual}, admin_user_id={admin_user_id}
ADMIN_WALLET_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.description: 腐竹账户余额不足。触发场景：续费 platform_managed 实例 / 提现申请时 balance < amount。实例保留 7 天宽限期（expiry_grace_until），玩家侧提示腐竹补缴。http_status=402 与方案 §3.2.3 对齐

ADMIN_WALLET_PENDING_NOT_SPENDABLE.message_template: Pending balance not spendable/withdrawable: admin_user_id={admin_user_id}, pending={pending}, release_after={release_after}
ADMIN_WALLET_PENDING_NOT_SPENDABLE.description: 冻结期分账余额不可消费/提现。触发场景：尝试使用 pending_balance 支付或提现。强制冻结期 settlement_delay_hours（默认 168h），仅 balance 可消费

ADMIN_WALLET_TRANSFER_FORBIDDEN.message_template: Transfer between wallets forbidden: from={from_wallet}, to={to_wallet}
ADMIN_WALLET_TRANSFER_FORBIDDEN.description: 账户体系隔离，禁止互转。触发场景：admin_wallets ↔ user_wallets 互转、admin_wallets 跨腐竹转账（防洗钱）。来源：方案 §4.3.2 不可支付场景

WITHDRAWAL_NOT_FOUND.description: 提现申请不存在。触发场景：审批/拒绝时查询未命中

WITHDRAWAL_NOT_PENDING.message_template: Withdrawal request not pending: withdrawal_id={withdrawal_id}, current_status={status}
WITHDRAWAL_NOT_PENDING.description: 提现申请非 pending 状态。触发场景：重复审批/重复拒绝

WITHDRAWAL_BELOW_MIN_AMOUNT.message_template: Withdrawal amount below minimum: requested={requested}, min={min}
WITHDRAWAL_BELOW_MIN_AMOUNT.description: 提现金额低于最低限额。触发场景：amount < economy.config withdrawal_min_amount（默认 10000 点券=100 元）

SETTLEMENT_RULE_NOT_FOUND.description: 分账规则不存在。触发场景：settlement_rules 查询未命中

SETTLEMENT_RULE_INVALID.message_template: Settlement rule invalid: platform_share={platform_share}, admin_share={admin_share}, reason={reason}
SETTLEMENT_RULE_INVALID.description: 分账规则非法。触发场景：platform_share + admin_share ≠ 1.0 / 比例越界 [0,1] / effective_until < effective_from

SETTLEMENT_RECORD_NOT_FOUND.description: 分账结算记录不存在。触发场景：settlement_records 查询未命中

ADMIN_TIER_NOT_FOUND.description: 腐竹等级配置不存在。触发场景：admin_tiers 查询未命中（migration 未初始化种子数据）

ADMIN_TIER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message_template: Admin tier limit exceeded: admin_user_id={admin_user_id}, resource={resource_type}, used={used}, limit={limit}, tier={tier}
ADMIN_TIER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: 腐竹等级限额已达上限。触发场景：创建实例超 max_instances / 新玩家绑定超 max_players_per_instance / 创建 API 密钥超 max_api_keys

ADMIN_TIER_FEATURE_LOCKED.message_template: Admin tier feature locked: feature={feature}, required_tier={required_tier}, current_tier={current_tier}
ADMIN_TIER_FEATURE_LOCKED.description: 高级功能未解锁。触发场景：tier 不足时使用跨服投票/跨服聊天/云备份/数据分析/自带节点接入（advanced_features 未包含该功能）

SELF_HOSTED_NODE_NOT_APPROVED.message_template: Self-hosted node not approved: node_id={node_id}, approval_status={approval_status}
SELF_HOSTED_NODE_NOT_APPROVED.description: 自带节点未通过审核。触发场景：node_source=self_hosted 且 approval_status != 'approved' 时创建/操作实例。需 server_admin 审核通过

INSTANCE_TYPE_PRICING_NOT_FOUND.message_template: Instance type pricing not found or archived: instance_type={instance_type}
INSTANCE_TYPE_PRICING_NOT_FOUND.description: 实例类型定价不存在或已归档。触发场景：instance_type_pricing 表查询未命中或 status='archived'。归档类型不可用于新计费，但存量记录保留

INSTANCE_BILLING_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND.message_template: Instance billing settings not found: instance_id={instance_id}
INSTANCE_BILLING_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND.description: 实例计费设置不存在。触发场景：instance_billing_settings 表查询未命中。正常流程应通过 getOrCreateBillingSettings 自动创建，未创建说明数据异常

INSTANCE_EXPIRED_NOT_RENEWED.message_template: Instance expired and not renewed, cannot start: instance_id={instance_id}, expiry_status={expiry_status}
INSTANCE_EXPIRED_NOT_RENEWED.description: 实例已过期且未续费，禁止启动。触发场景：servers.billing_type='vps_prepaid' 且 expiry_status ∈ {grace, expired} 时调用 startInstance。需先续费恢复 expiry_status='active'

BILLING_EXEMPT_CONFLICT.message_template: Billing exempt conflict: instance_id={instance_id}, exempt_reason={exempt_reason}, attempted_action={action}
BILLING_EXEMPT_CONFLICT.description: 计费豁免冲突。触发场景：对豁免实例（billing_exempt=true）执行强制扣款，或豁免原因与节点状态不一致（如 self_hosted 节点被拒绝后仍尝试豁免）

INVALID_BILLING_CYCLE.message_template: Invalid billing cycle: cycle_months={cycle_months}, allowed values are 1, 3, 6, 12
INVALID_BILLING_CYCLE.description: 计费周期非法。触发场景：cycleMonths 不在 {1, 3, 6, 12} 范围内。VPS 计费仅支持月付/季付/半年付/年付

GLOBAL_BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT.message_template: Global balance insufficient: user_id={user_id}, required={required}, available={available}
GLOBAL_BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT.description: 腐竹全局余额不足（global_balances 表，通过 user_id 隔离）。触发场景：VPS 计费扣款时 balanceService.debit 检测到 (balance - frozen_balance) < amount。区别于 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE(400, 玩家 user_wallets) 与 ADMIN_WALLET_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE(402, 腐竹 admin_wallets)。来源：docs/plans/instance-billing-rules-plan.md §4.1
